address: 4742 Hills and Dales Rd NW, Canton, OH 44708
dish: Fresh yeast doughnuts, apple fritters and cinnamon rolls
w: Family-owned Jackson Township doughnut shop. One of Cleveland Magazine's 21 must-go spots in Canton and ranked in Akron Life's 2026 330 Flavor Awards Best Doughnuts (reader vote).

dish: Linguine and shrimp, Moscato chicken and shrimp, duck and gnocchi
w: Downtown Canton bistro with a formal room but a casual, buzzy feel. On Cleveland Magazine's 21 must-go spots in Canton and the Canton Repository's 'Eat your way through downtown Canton' guide.

dish: Scratch-made falafel and hummus (the family's recipes) in build-your-own pitas and rice bowls
w: Sibling-run Middle Eastern carryout opened 2017 ('where east meets west'). Profiled by Akron Life ('Middle Ground'), in Cleveland Magazine's Cuyahoga Falls best-restaurants guide, and measured as Ohio's #2-rated restaurant (4.8 stars, 250+ reviews) in a USA TODAY Network ratings roundup.

dish: Strasburg Meats sausage sub and homemade chili
w: Sports grill (2023) beside the Canton Palace Theatre that revived the bar and dining room of the 1960s Downtowner Motor Inn, retro decor intact — entered through a giant leather football helmet. Reviewed by the Canton Repository and picked in Akron Life's '6 newer spots to eat in Canton'.
